title: Twist E28: Heldout family selection and an honest solver portfolio
status_note: Proposed E28; not started. Verified candidates, complete counters, a frozen selector and unopened final target set are required. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Verified candidates, complete counters, a frozen selector and unopened final target set are required.
question: Can a selector using only public instance features improve cold one-target IC after all search and selection costs are included?
decision_value: A complete-cost reduction on the sealed final population supports an adaptive engineering improvement and justifies independent replication of this frozen selector. A training-only gain, oracle result or failed heldout transfer does not support that conclusion.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, at most four configurations and two budgeted pilot probes per target; 120 seconds total per selector cell, including probes. Final resource estimates await E27. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.
